name: CSPC Innovation Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: CSPC Innovation Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of biopharmaceuticals, functional foods, and raw materials in China and internationally. The company offers functional raw ingredients, including caffeine, acarbose, anhydrous glucose, theophylline, aminophylline, dyphylline, theobromine, pentoxifylline, and doxofylline; and health food products, such as Guoweikang Vitamin C tablets, Guoweikang B vitamin lozenges, etc. It also provides technology transfer and technical consulting services of biotechnology.
